question: The proportion of GDP contributed by the industrial sector increased in the period from 11.8 per cent in 1950-51 to _________ per cent in 1990-91.
solution:
The correct answer is __**24.6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The proportion of GDP contributed by the industrial sector increased in the period from 11.8 per cent in 1950-51 to 24.6 per cent in 1990-91.&
